The main takeaway from our work is that

the design of experiments for pairwise comparison of two treatments can be significantly improved by taking into account the structure of the experimental data and using the information about the treatment effects in the design process.
the optimal design is not a simple function of the experimental parameters and is not necessarily the same for all experimental parameters.
